sentences.text: The offences alleged are under Sections 270, 273 r/w 34 IPC and Sections 5 (1) and 22 of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003.

entities.text: Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: This Court has heard Sri Raja Reddy Koneti, learned counsel for the petitioners and learned Public Prosecutor for respondent-State.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that in a similar case, this Court, by virtue of common order in Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, quashed the proceedings against the petitioners therein by considering that transportation of Gutka is not attracted by the offences alleged under Sections 188, 270 and 273 of IPC and Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
A perusal of the order shows that this Court, by considering that transportation of Gutka does not attract the offences alleged, quashed the proceedings.

Hence, following the said order and in terms thereof, the criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners-Accused 1, 2 and 4 in FIR.No.10 of 2019 on the file of Rajahmundry I Town Police Station, Rajamahendravaram, are hereby quashed.
